Paste error traceback here

## Environment

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Cis-GS version | e.g. `cis-gs --version` |
| Installation method | PyPI / .exe / from source |

## Input Details

- Genome assembly (species + version, e.g. *A. hypogaea* Tifrunner gnm2)
- GFF3 source
